:::{#exr-sum-deviations-zero}
#### Summing the deviations from the mean

Find $\sumin (\rvar_\iobs - \bar{x})$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-sum-deviations-zero}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sumin (\rvar_\iobs - \bar{x})
&= \sumin \rvar_\iobs - \sumin \bar{x}
&& \text{(split the sum)}\\
&= \sumin \rvar_\iobs - n \bar{x}
&& \text{(sum of a constant)}\\
&= n \bar{x} - n \bar{x}
&& \text{($\sumin \rvar_\iobs = n \bar{x}$)}\\
&= 0
&& \text{(subtract)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The same steps with $\outvar_\iobs$ in place of $\rvar_\iobs$
show that $\sumin (\outvar_\iobs - \bar{y}) = 0$.

:::
